summary: Elevate your NGO's donor reporting skills with our expert-led training. Learn to communicate impact effectively and foster stronger relationships with funders.
lede: Donor reporting for environmental NGOs brings project evidence, financial information, and ecological results into structured grant updates. For professionals who work with NGO project data or grant compliance, the course develops skills in aligning indicators with logframes, checking evidence quality, and writing outcome-focused narratives. It also covers budget-versus-actual analysis, environmental impact summaries, and compliance records to support clear, traceable reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with NGO project data, donor templates, or grant compliance and now need stronger reporting capability in environmental programmes.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and access to one anonymised project report, budget summary, or indicator list if available. Familiarity with basic NGO reporting terminology will help you get more value from the exercises.
